# DeepTip

> DeepTip is a UI design pattern: explanation windows with depth (nested, pinnable tooltips like in Paradox Interactive's games). Rest on an element and a window explains it; highlighted terms open further windows; a click pins them; pinned windows contain terms again. Content is data: one JSON glossary per language with [[key]] links. This repository holds the specification, the glossary schema and validator, shared test cases, the code in HTML/CSS/JavaScript and Rust, and an exact guide for every other framework.

Synonyms: DeepTooltip, 3DTooltip, DimTip, nested tooltips, Paradox tooltips, tooltips in tooltips, Erklärfenster. The specification is the contract; the web runtime is the reference implementation; docs/algorithms.md describes its algorithms step by step so DeepTip can be rebuilt in any language.

## Docs

- [Briefing for any language model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/docs/prompt.md): what DeepTip means and how to build it, in one page
- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/SPEC.md): data format, behaviour, placement, input, accessibility, options, porting checklist
- [Algorithms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/docs/algorithms.md): the exact algorithms of the reference as language-neutral pseudo-code (glossary layers, markup parser, window tree, grace and tendency, arming, timer lock, placement, input, auto-linking, encyclopedia)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/README.md): the pattern, the frameworks, the tools
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/AGENTS.md): how to add DeepTip to a project or port it to a new framework

## Data

- [Glossary JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/schema/deeptip.schema.json)
- [Core glossary, English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/glossary/core/en.json)
- [Example glossary, English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/glossary/example/en.json): used by every framework's example
- [Parity cases: markup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/test/cases/markup.json), [placement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/test/cases/placement.json), [glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/test/cases/glossary.json)

## Frameworks

- [Web (HTML + CSS + JavaScript), reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/frameworks/web/README.md)
- Code: `frameworks/<name>/README.md` for RPG Maker MZ (`rpgmaker-mz`, JavaScript plugin) and Rust/egui (`rust-egui`)
- Exact guides, no code: `frameworks/<name>/README.md` for TypeScript, Svelte, React, Vue, Blazor (on the web runtime), Avalonia, Unity, Valheim, Godot, Python/PySide6 (`python-pyside6`), Java/Swing (`java-swing`), Kotlin/Compose (`kotlin-compose`), C++/Dear ImGui (`cpp-imgui`), C++/Unreal (`cpp-unreal`), Swift/SwiftUI (`swift-swiftui`), Go/Gio (`go-gio`)
